name: idoft-plcx
detail:
install with python 3.10: error: No solution found when resolving dependencies
  cause: Because only plcx==0.8 is available and plcx==0.8 depends on pytest==5.2.2, we can conclude that all versions of plcx depend on pytest==5.2.2.
         And because you require pytest>=7,<8 and plcx, we can conclude that your requirements are unsatisfiable.
